question: Do mutations causing low HDL-C promote increased carotid intima-media thickness?
original_answer: No, the study found that cIMT was nearly identical between cases and controls.
original_explanation: The results section states that cIMT was nearly identical between cases (0.66+/-0.17 cm) and controls (0.65+/-0.18 cm), even though the cases had significantly lower HDL cholesterol.
